## Problem

<!-- What is wrong, who or what is affected, and what is the root cause? -->

## Solution

<!-- What changed, what behavior or invariant now holds, and why this approach? -->

## Potential risks

<!-- What could regress, what remains unverified, or what tradeoffs does this introduce? If none, explain why. -->

## Verification

<!-- List the checks, tests, screenshots, or manual validation performed. -->

## Submit checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused and has a scoped Conventional Commits title, such as `feat(scope): summary` or `fix(scope): summary`.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks, or explained why they were not run.
- [ ] The description begins with `Problem`, `Solution`, and `Potential risks`, in that order.
- [ ] No secrets, private config, generated output, or unrelated formatting changes are included.
- [ ] Docs, screenshots, and locale updates are included when the change needs them.
